candidats.description: A paving compactor left on top of a storm drain during heavy rain. Oily looking water flowed down the storm drain and directly into Francis Creek adjacent to Main Street.

candidats.description: South Rim Greenway Construction August 2011. Grand Canyon's greenway trail system is a multi-modal, accessible trail system that encourages non-motorized travel, complementing the park's free shuttle system which includes seasonal shuttle bus service to and from Tusayan. Greenway III (the Tusayan Greenway), on the South Rim, consists of a 9-foot wide, compacted soil surface for pedestrians and bicyclists, with a wide shoulder area that may be used by equestrians.
